note: Kiro uses the Kiro.dev model configuration. Models are set in .kiro/settings.json or via the Kiro CLI. Kiro supports model-per-agent via frontmatter or settings.

tier-s.rationale: Kiro's agent system can bind different models to different agents. Use Sonnet for design and implementation — best code reasoning available.

tier-a.rationale: Spec and validation agents benefit from the same model as tier-s. Kiro allows per-agent binding, so no need to downgrade.

tier-b.rationale: Kiro's frontmatter supports 'model' field. Set tier-b agents to gpt-4o-mini for discovery, domain, and task planning.

tier-c.rationale: Lite and knowledge agents run most frequently. gpt-4o-mini provides the best throughput at the lowest cost.
